grade: infobox figures 3121707, 13971006, 16366641; place true, population true
answer:
Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup. Its capital is Buenos Aires, and Wikipedia's Buenos Aires article gives the city's population as **3,121,707** (2022 census, "Capital and autonomous city").

The same article also gives larger figures for the urban area (13,971,006) and the metro area (16,366,641). The 3,121,707 figure is for the city itself.

The Buenos Aires Wikipedia page is still open in the browser tab.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022_FIFA_World_Cup; agent-browser --session $S eval "document.querySelector('.infobox')?.innerText.slice(0,600)"
